instruction:
You are tasked with designing a module in Verilog that implements a Full Adder circuit. The Full Adder circuit takes three inputs: A, B, and Ci (Carry-in). The circuit outputs two values: S (Sum) and Co (Carry-out).

Your module should be named "Full_Adder" and should have the following ports:
- A (input): A single bit representing the first input to the Full Adder circuit.
- B (input): A single bit representing the second input to the Full Adder circuit.
- Ci (input): A single bit representing the carry-in to the Full Adder circuit.
- S (output): A single bit representing the sum output of the Full Adder circuit.
- Co (output): A single bit representing the carry-out output of the Full Adder circuit.

Your module should implement the Full Adder circuit using only one module within 200 lines of Verilog code. You are not allowed to use any built-in Verilog modules or primitives.
